description: A `<*f/>` cycle through a use guarded by the new instance's own graph field is legal and renders: each new `<card>` starts in the arm without `<*ph/>` (#2139 r1 re-review HIGH-1).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-star-self-render-error ("it is the same field of the same instance at every level, so any guard gives the same answer at every level"); PA reading pa-ruled:S483-star-cycle-same-instance (a cycle that crosses a use and is guarded by that new instance's own state is not that shape)
rationale: §66.6.2 rule 1 (S483 r2): a guard on a new instance's own writable state ends the walk — each instance's state is its own and starts again from its initial value.
